verdict.rationale: Shopify's docs show a Liquid templating layer (Liquid templates are validated against Shopify schemas) and an official CLI that works with themes and custom storefronts, so the core of storefront code customization is the product's own capability. The pack does not document a theme local-preview workflow; dev stores are described only for apps via `shopify app dev`. Nor does it show version-controlled theme deploys. missing for 10: documented Liquid templating reference, local theme preview server, version-controlled/Git-based theme deploys, independent hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a developer, I can customize storefront code with a documented templating layer, local preview, and version-controlled theme deploys

citations.quote: Code validation: validate GraphQL queries, Liquid templates, and Shopify Extensions against Shopify schemas
Shopify CLI is a command-line interface tool that helps you generate and work with Shopify apps, themes and custom storefronts.
Help merchants express their unique brand by building a custom theme or Hydrogen storefront.
